propositions: The documented curl-based commit-msg hook install command using `git rev-parse --git-path hooks/commit-msg` targets the shared hooks directory from linked worktrees, silently clobbering the pre-commit wrapper in the main checkout instead of installing locally.
The bare curl overwrites the pre-commit migration chain, breaking Change-Id stamping and the pre-commit 50/72 message gate, with failures only surfacing later at push time in a different worktree.

The hook installation must be made worktree-safe and idempotent by consolidating into a single documented path (`make hooks`) and installing to `commit-msg.legacy` when a pre-commit wrapper already owns the `commit-msg` slot.
Documentation in AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md must be updated to remove instructions for the unsafe bare curl command and reference the consolidated `make hooks` approach instead.
